Hi Alex / team — thanks for the quick confirmation. Per Alex’s note, we’ll target delivering the package today EOD. Quick notes on contents:

- Redwood_SOC2_Package_v1.zip: includes SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted), control mappings (by domain), and exportable logs summary.
- SOC2_Questionnaire_Fillable.pdf: fillable copy with guidance notes in the first tab.
- One-page KM & Retention narrative (below) — I’ve pasted two short paragraphs per Rajiv’s ask.

Key management & retention (brief):
Redwood uses customer-key encryption for sensitive customer data at rest where customers opt in; key management leverages our KMS integrations (AWS KMS and customer-supplied HSM). Access to KMS is restricted via least-privilege IAM roles and audited with rotation policies enforced quarterly.
Data retention: default logs and telemetry are retained for 90 days; customer data in the inference layer may be configured by customers (retention options: 0 days, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days) and can be disabled for Private deployments. All retention settings are documented and auditable via the Console.
